trust_center.repositoryDescription: Paramify-hosted Trust Center publishing our FedRAMP compliance posture, control implementation status. Documentation is available to approved visitors upon request.
trust_center.accessRequestInstructions: Go to Request Access -> Fill in the required information under Trust Center Access Request -> Submit for approval. Once approved, you will receive an email notification. Return to the Trust Center and login via the email option to access the requested deliverables.

secure_configuration_guidance.repositoryDescription: Secure Configuration Guide (SCG) is provided by Vbrick Systems, Inc. to support agency customers in deploying and administering Vbrick EVP.

certified_services.serviceDescription: Upload through the browser, API or customer devices; storage in tenant-specific encrypted storage; optional transcoding; permission management; and authenticated playback, including CDN-accelerated delivery.
Authenticated access and unified URLs for live webcasts, including cloud live streaming through CloudFront.
Connection to SIP-enabled conferences, with recordings ingested and processed as video on demand.
Cloud-side endpoints for streaming and recording from Microsoft Teams and Webex meetings.
Local accounts, SAML single sign-on, and LDAP/SCIM-based user and group synchronization and authentication (cloud side).

certified_services.serviceName: Public REST API and Application Integrations
certified_services.serviceDescription: Authenticated API access for uploads, downloads and integrated applications.
Optional automated transcription and translation of video audio tracks.
Optional automatic titles, descriptions, tags, chapters, summaries, semantic search and chat with video content.
Optional narration and spoken renditions of video metadata.
Optional discovery and tagging of users in videos based on profile pictures.

System-generated email notifications to tenant users.

current.service_desc: Vbrick Enterprise Video Platform (EVP) is a multi-tenant Software as a Service (SaaS) offering, operated on Amazon Web Services, that enables organizations to securely deliver live and on-demand video to organizational users, anonymous users, or both. It provides central management of video assets, user access and permissions, network delivery devices, and video publishing and distribution, and integrates with customer directory services, single sign-on, and applications such as Microsoft Teams, Webex and SharePoint.
